preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The number of cities n is between 2 and 50,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= r2 <= n and r1 != r2
preconditions.description: The old capital r1 and new capital r2 are distinct integers between 1 and n.
The second line contains exactly n-1 integers representing the parent pointers for all cities except r1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p_list)
preconditions.description: All parent pointers in the input are valid city indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in output_parts)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid city index between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(new_parent[i] == parent_in_tree_r2[i] for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != r2)
postconditions.description: For every city i (except the new capital r2), the i-th output value (mapped by index order) equals the index of the immediate neighbor of i on the unique path from r2 to i in the original tree structure.
The output text is the space-separated concatenation of the computed parent pointers.
